paragraphs.source_en: Bungo hurriedly surveyed his surroundings. The scout had stated quite clearly that at least a hundred horses were tethered here. They were, of course, farmhorses raised by prosperous farmers. Ever since the Sanada father and son had come to live here, riding had become customary among the villagers and, together with their schoolless, unorthodox swordsmanship, had shaped the local way of life.

units.source_en: Bungo hurriedly surveyed his surroundings.
units.source_zh: 丰后急急打量四周。

units.source_en: The scout had stated quite clearly that at least a hundred horses were tethered here.

ja.t: がつながれているということだった。

units.source_zh: 探子说得清清楚楚，这里拴着至少一百多匹马。

units.source_en: They were, of course, farmhorses raised by prosperous farmers.
units.source_zh: 当然，都是些富有的农夫喂养的耕马。

units.source_en: Ever since the Sanada father and son had come to live here, riding had become customary among the villagers and, together with their schoolless, unorthodox swordsmanship, had shaped the local way of life.
units.source_zh: 自从真田父子住到此地，骑马就成了乡人的习惯，与无门无派的剑术一起，形成了此地的风尚。

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰后急急打量四周。探子说得清清楚楚，这里拴着至少一百多匹马。当然，都是些富有的农夫喂养的耕马。自从真田父子住到此地，骑马就成了乡人的习惯，与无门无派的剑术一起，形成了此地的风尚。

paragraphs.source_en: Damn! Shigemasa rushed farther in through the darkness. There were tethering posts everywhere, yet not a single horse. The sharp smell of fresh dung struck his nostrils, yet not so much as a single horsehair remained!

units.source_en: Damn!
units.source_zh: 糟！

units.source_en: Shigemasa rushed farther in through the darkness.
units.source_zh: 重正慌忙在黑暗中向内闯。

units.source_en: There were tethering posts everywhere, yet not a single horse.
units.source_zh: 那么多拴马桩，却无一匹马。

units.source_en: The sharp smell of fresh dung struck his nostrils, yet not so much as a single horsehair remained!
units.source_zh: 新鲜的马粪气味直冲鼻子，却连马毛也无一根！

paragraphs.source_zh: 糟！重正慌忙在黑暗中向内闯。那么多拴马桩，却无一匹马。新鲜的马粪气味直冲鼻子，却连马毛也无一根！

paragraphs.source_en: “All of you, charge in!” Shigemasa burst into a room where a light was still burning and at once closed his eyes in despair. Men lay snoring all over the floor amid the wreckage of the feast, like tuna cast ashore by a mighty wave. This was no ordinary drunken stupor; they must have been drugged.

units.source_en: “All of you, charge in!”
units.source_zh: “都给我上！”

units.source_en: Shigemasa burst into a room where a light was still burning and at once closed his eyes in despair.
units.source_zh: 重正闯进尚留有灯火的屋内，立时绝望地闭上双目。

units.source_en: Men lay snoring all over the floor amid the wreckage of the feast, like tuna cast ashore by a mighty wave.

ja.t: のように、そこかしこで

units.source_zh: 在杯盘狼藉的地上，到处都躺着呼呼大睡的男子，仿佛被巨浪打上海岸的金枪鱼。

units.source_en: This was no ordinary drunken stupor; they must have been drugged.
units.source_zh: 这绝非寻常的大醉，必是被施了迷药。

paragraphs.source_zh: “都给我上！”重正闯进尚留有灯火的屋内，立时绝望地闭上双目。在杯盘狼藉的地上，到处都躺着呼呼大睡的男子，仿佛被巨浪打上海岸的金枪鱼。这绝非寻常的大醉，必是被施了迷药。

paragraphs.source_en: His men crowded in behind him.

units.source_en: His men crowded in behind him.
units.source_zh: 手下人齐齐拥了进来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Wh-what has happened here?” one man shouted. “Why isn’t there a single fellow still awake?”

units.source_en: “Wh-what has happened here?”
units.source_zh: “这……这是怎回事？”

units.source_en: one man shouted. “Why isn’t there a single fellow still awake?”
units.source_zh: 一个人大声喊道，“怎的一个清醒的家伙也没有！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这……这是怎回事？”一个人大声喊道，“怎的一个清醒的家伙也没有！”

paragraphs.source_en: “Sanada Saemon-no-Suke Yukimura has fled, damn him! If he has any courage, let him come out with a real blade and fight me!”

units.source_en: “Sanada Saemon-no-Suke Yukimura has fled, damn him!
units.source_zh: “真田左卫门佐幸村逃了，哼！

units.source_en: If he has any courage, let him come out with a real blade and fight me!”
units.source_zh: 有种的真刀真枪出来，比试比试！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “真田左卫门佐幸村逃了，哼！有种的真刀真枪出来，比试比试！”

units.source_en: “Hmph!”

paragraphs.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa’s face had gone deathly pale; anguish seared his heart, while a chill kept running down his spine. He savagely kicked one of the men beside him. “Get up, you fool!”

units.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa’s face had gone deathly pale; anguish seared his heart, while a chill kept running down his spine.
units.source_zh: 松仓重正脸色煞白，心中如煎，脊梁还在飕飕冒着凉气。

units.source_en: He savagely kicked one of the men beside him. “Get up, you fool!”
units.source_zh: 他狠狠朝身边一人踢了一脚，“起来，蠢货！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 松仓重正脸色煞白，心中如煎，脊梁还在飕飕冒着凉气。他狠狠朝身边一人踢了一脚，“起来，蠢货！”

paragraphs.source_en: The man merely mumbled some nonsense, stirred one hand slightly, and went on snoring thunderously. Dead drunk, they were luxuriating in their deep slumber.

units.source_en: The man merely mumbled some nonsense, stirred one hand slightly, and went on snoring thunderously.

ja.t: のようないびきをかき

units.source_zh: 被踢之人只是嘴里嘟囔着，胡言几句，微微动一动手，继续鼾声如雷。

units.source_en: Dead drunk, they were luxuriating in their deep slumber.
units.source_zh: 他们烂醉如泥，在享受着大睡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 被踢之人只是嘴里嘟囔着，胡言几句，微微动一动手，继续鼾声如雷。他们烂醉如泥，在享受着大睡。

paragraphs.source_en: What a disgraceful night raid it had proved to be. In truth, Yukimura’s spending two days fishing had been the first hint of this stratagem—the cicada shedding its shell. Spending two days catching carp and then waiting another two days for the banquet before departing had been strange from the outset, but Yukimura had carried it off so convincingly that he truly deceived everyone.

units.source_en: What a disgraceful night raid it had proved to be.
units.source_zh: 真是一次丢人现眼的夜袭。

units.source_en: In truth, Yukimura’s spending two days fishing had been the first hint of this stratagem—the cicada shedding its shell.
units.source_zh: 原本，幸村花两日时间捕鱼，就是此次金蝉脱壳最初的暗示。

units.source_en: Spending two days catching carp and then waiting another two days for the banquet before departing had been strange from the outset, but Yukimura had carried it off so convincingly that he truly deceived everyone.

ja.t: するというのは、もともとどこか

units.source_zh: 捕捞鲤鱼花两日，酒宴两日后才出发，本就有些古怪，但幸村做得太真了，实能迷惑众人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 真是一次丢人现眼的夜袭。原本，幸村花两日时间捕鱼，就是此次金蝉脱壳最初的暗示。捕捞鲤鱼花两日，酒宴两日后才出发，本就有些古怪，但幸村做得太真了，实能迷惑众人。

paragraphs.source_en: Was Yukimura truly in such haste to reach Osaka Castle? Did he hope to gain those five hundred thousand koku and rise in the world, or did he simply relish the pleasure of making fools of others? Matsukura Shigemasa thought only of returning to Gojo as quickly as possible and stopping Yukimura there. If he could not recover his honor, how could he ever hold up his head again?

units.source_en: Was Yukimura truly in such haste to reach Osaka Castle?
units.source_zh: 幸村就那般急切去大坂城？

units.source_en: Did he hope to gain those five hundred thousand koku and rise in the world, or did he simply relish the pleasure of making fools of others?

ja.t: しようというのか、それとも

units.source_zh: 他是想得到那五十万石，出人头地，还是喜欢享受戏耍别人的乐趣？

units.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa thought only of returning to Gojo as quickly as possible and stopping Yukimura there.
units.source_zh: 松仓重正只想尽快返回五条，于那里阻止幸村。

units.source_en: If he could not recover his honor, how could he ever hold up his head again?

ja.t: せなければ、いったいどんな

units.source_zh: 若不能挽回颜面，他有何立足之地？

paragraphs.source_zh: 幸村就那般急切去大坂城？他是想得到那五十万石，出人头地，还是喜欢享受戏耍别人的乐趣？松仓重正只想尽快返回五条，于那里阻止幸村。若不能挽回颜面，他有何立足之地？

paragraphs.source_en: But precisely because of that single misstep, withdrawing his troops in the middle of the night was now far from simple. Shigemasa relayed orders while contacting the various detachments; by the time he had assembled all five hundred men, many hours had passed, and when they finally returned to Gojo, broad daylight had already come.

units.source_en: But precisely because of that single misstep, withdrawing his troops in the middle of the night was now far from simple.
units.source_zh: 但正因他一步走错，如今深夜撤兵，远无那般简单。

units.source_en: Shigemasa relayed orders while contacting the various detachments; by the time he had assembled all five hundred men, many hours had passed, and when they finally returned to Gojo, broad daylight had already come.

ja.t: させるころには、すでにかなりの

units.source_zh: 重正一边传达命令，一边与各处联络，待把五百人集中起来，过了不少时辰，再返回五条，天已大亮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但正因他一步走错，如今深夜撤兵，远无那般简单。重正一边传达命令，一边与各处联络，待把五百人集中起来，过了不少时辰，再返回五条，天已大亮。

paragraphs.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa had suffered the greatest failure of his life. His adversary had slipped quietly away and by now was probably far beyond his reach. How was he to answer to Lord Ieyasu and Sanada Izu-no-Kami in Ueda?

units.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa had suffered the greatest failure of his life.
units.source_zh: 松仓重正遭遇了一生最大的一次失败。

units.source_en: His adversary had slipped quietly away and by now was probably far beyond his reach.
units.source_zh: 对手悄然而去，此时恐已远走高飞。

units.source_en: How was he to answer to Lord Ieyasu and Sanada Izu-no-Kami in Ueda?
units.source_zh: 当如何向家康公和上田的真田伊豆守交代？

paragraphs.source_zh: 松仓重正遭遇了一生最大的一次失败。对手悄然而去，此时恐已远走高飞。当如何向家康公和上田的真田伊豆守交代？

paragraphs.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa had only just returned to his headquarters when a subordinate came to report: “More than a hundred horses are tethered in the woods by Futami Shrine, and a letter is tied to a pine branch.”

units.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa had only just returned to his headquarters when a subordinate came to report: “More than a hundred horses are tethered in the woods by Futami Shrine, and a letter is tied to a pine branch.”
units.source_zh: 松仓重正返回大帐未久，手下前来禀报：“二见神社树林里拴有一百多匹马，松枝上系着一封书函。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 松仓重正返回大帐未久，手下前来禀报：“二见神社树林里拴有一百多匹马，松枝上系着一封书函。”

paragraphs.source_en: When the soldier presented the letter, Matsukura Bungo was both astonished and deeply moved.

units.source_en: When the soldier presented the letter, Matsukura Bungo was both astonished and deeply moved.
units.source_zh: 当士卒奉上书函时，松仓丰后又是吃惊又是感叹。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当士卒奉上书函时，松仓丰后又是吃惊又是感叹。

paragraphs.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa first burst into laughter, but as he laughed, tears suddenly began streaming down his cheeks. Yes—this father and son were pitiable men, admirable men, who had devoted themselves utterly to their unwavering purpose!

units.source_en: Matsukura Shigemasa first burst into laughter, but as he laughed, tears suddenly began streaming down his cheeks.
units.source_zh: 松仓重正先是大笑，笑着笑着，眼泪竟簌簌落了下来。

units.source_en: Yes—this father and son were pitiable men, admirable men, who had devoted themselves utterly to their unwavering purpose!
units.source_zh: 是啊，此父子二人就是为执著献身的可悲之人、可敬之人！

paragraphs.source_zh: 松仓重正先是大笑，笑着笑着，眼泪竟簌簌落了下来。是啊，此父子二人就是为执著献身的可悲之人、可敬之人！

paragraphs.source_en: At the thought, Shigemasa even fell under the illusion that he himself had deliberately allowed the Sanada father and son to escape. He hastily cast a furtive glance around him and cursed inwardly: You damned scoundrel—you have landed me in misery!

units.source_en: At the thought, Shigemasa even fell under the illusion that he himself had deliberately allowed the Sanada father and son to escape.
units.source_zh: 想到这里，重正甚至产生了自己乃是故意放走真田父子的错觉。

units.source_en: He hastily cast a furtive glance around him and cursed inwardly: You damned scoundrel—you have landed me in misery!
units.source_zh: 他连忙偷偷望一眼四周，暗骂：混账东西，你把老子坑苦了！

paragraphs.source_zh: 想到这里，重正甚至产生了自己乃是故意放走真田父子的错觉。他连忙偷偷望一眼四周，暗骂：混账东西，你把老子坑苦了！
